title: Mage Equipment Token Master
description: Mage Equipment Token Master — The Townstons wiki
html:
Mage Equip Token Master

The Mage Token Master in the north section of Townston offers players a chance to trade Kings Coins for yellow items in their class. Each item is randomly drawn from a category a player chooses. The categories available are Mage Rings, Mage Amulets, Mage armor, Shoulder armor, One-Handed and Two-handed Mage Weapon, Mage gloves and Mage boots. The price varies based on which type of armor you select, and is more for non-members.

There is a small chance that she will give purple items instead of yellow, and even a smaller chance that the Token Master will give you a Rainbow item. Items sold are immediately soulbound to the buyer.
